g.text: Illustrative constant-elasticity demand P = P₀(1 + X/S₀)^(−1/ε) with P₀ = US$ 55 000/kg (≈ US$ 1 700 per troy ounce, October 2026; the price ranged
from about US$ 1 540 to 2 920 per ounce during 2026) and S₀ = 170 t/yr (world mine supply, WPIC 2025).
